posts.title: RH HEX frog — luxury mascot
posts.content:
## Result

Seed mascot for PulseChain Garden — Richard Heart as a smug green frog, HEX pendant, iced Cubans, pink/red monogram bomber.

## Prompt (recreate / variants)

```
3D character portrait of a smug anthropomorphic green frog with Richard Heart's side-parted dirty-blonde hair and small goatee, wide pepe grin showing white teeth, half-lidded confident eyes, leaning forward with chin resting on interlaced hands, one foot raised, wearing a pink and red Gucci-monogram zip bomber with black-white striped rib cuffs, two thick iced-out Cuban link chains with a large jeweled HEX hexagon pendant in pink-orange-yellow gradient, photoreal skin texture, studio lighting, shallow depth of field indoor background
```

## Notes

- Keep HEX pendant readable; models often melt the hex.
- Swap bomber colors to Pulse teal for a PulseChain variant.
- Good face/body ref for later likeness locks.

posts.title: PulseChain neon city night
posts.content:
## Prompt

```
wide night cityscape on PulseChain, teal and magenta neon signage reflected in wet asphalt, distant hexagonal tower glowing pulse-green, anamorphic lens flare, cinematic 1980s sci-fi still, deep blacks, no readable brand logos, photoreal
```

## Notes

- Good environment plate for compositing RH later.
- Keep logos abstract — models love inventing fake tickers.

posts.title: RH on stage — concert still
posts.content:
## Prompt

```
Richard Heart on stage under teal spotlights, exact facial likeness, black shirt, crowd as dark silhouettes, concert photography, shallow depth of field, stage haze, high ISO grain, keep expression confident and natural
```

## Notes

- Pair with a real stage photo as image 1 for pose lock.
- Avoid inventing microphones that cover the face.

posts.title: HEX monumental type poster
posts.content:
## Prompt

```
huge letters "HEX" fill the entire composition top to bottom and across, no empty space, black outside the letters, only within the letters is a glowing teal pulse lattice and gold filament light, heavy risograph grain, cyber-finance poster, sacred geometry --chaos 40 --ar 3:1 --raw --stylize 900 --v 7
```

## Notes

- Works as a banner / header asset.
- Try `PULSE` or `PLS` as alternate letter stacks.

posts.title: Richard Heart portrait — teal rim
posts.content:
## Prompt

```
cinematic portrait of Richard Heart, exact facial likeness and expression, teal rim light from camera-right, deep black studio backdrop, subtle PulseChain green accent glow on cheek edge, shot on 85mm f/1.8, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, high contrast, no text, no logos --ar 3:4 --stylize 250 --v 7
```

## Notes

- Drop a clean face ref in `img-ref/` and keep likeness language explicit.
- Swap teal for gold if you want a HEX-forward grade.
